wants.title: Tractor, 90-140hp, with front-end loader
must: known manufacturer: John Deere, Case, Kubota, New Holland, Massey Ferguson, McCormick, Lovol or better
wants.notes: Build quality matters more than hours alone. A tidy 3,000-hour Deere beats a rough 1,500-hour no-name.

wants.title: Portable home, container or similar, 2+ rooms with bathroom
wants.notes: Price band tracks quality: 5k for a rough site hut, 30k for a finished container home. Transport cost is worth noting separately.

wants.title: Chainsaw, Stihl or Husqvarna, 30 inch bar capable
must: rated to carry a 30 inch bar (e.g. Stihl MS 462, MS 500i, Husqvarna 572 XP, 592 XP)
wants.notes: New MS 462 sits near the top of the band, so a clean used saw with a bar is the value play.

wants.title: Offset discs, 24-32 plate, for a 90-130hp tractor
prefer: plates with life left, not dished out
wants.notes: Width is the hard constraint: anything over 3.5 m is too much for the tractor and too wide to cart.

wants.title: Deep tyne ripper for tree roots
must: deep tynes, built for tree roots and hard ground
wants.notes: Root ripping punishes gear. Heavy frame and shank protection matter more than tyne count.
